subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Which lifecycle contract should automatic daily and idle rollover expose to persistence consumers?
rationale: Current main separates internal command hooks from typed plugin lifecycle hooks, so selecting whether to extend before_reset, add a reset event, or synthesize command events is a compatibility-sensitive API decision.

options.title: Extend typed reset lifecycle
options.body: Route every rollover reason through a canonical typed reset helper and adapt bundled session-memory at its owning boundary without presenting automatic rollover as a user command.

options.title: Reuse command reset events
options.body: Emit synthetic command events with daily or idle metadata, reducing implementation work but conflating command and lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Add a session reset event
options.body: Create a distinct internal session reset event while retaining separate typed plugin behavior, accepting another public hook surface.

recommendation.title: Extend typed reset lifecycle
recommendation.body: Route every rollover reason through a canonical typed reset helper and adapt bundled session-memory at its owning boundary without presenting automatic rollover as a user command.

likelyOwner.reason: The active hooks/plugins candidate and issue history most directly route this contract decision to vincentkoc.
